entities.name: Aerid Konstrari
entities.description: The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven's Konstrari school, who can animate inert materials with a heartwood crystal and remains its dean.

entities.name: Denzilore Fatehold
entities.description: The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven's Fatehold school and its dean.

entities.name: Ingris Stingerquill
entities.description: The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven's Stingerquill school and its dean.

entities.name: Kwia Vigorbloom
entities.description: The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven's Vigorbloom school, able to grow and manipulate plant matter.

entities.name: Uldaros Theorix
entities.description: The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven's Theorix school, who built the original fortress of Hexhaven with reality-bending magic.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The academy on Arcavios founded by the five Founder Sphinxes.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: Echoverse version of Liliana Vess, a healer and professor at Hexhaven whose planeswalker spark never ignited; she has a cloying, saccharine demeanor.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, who in the Echoverse never died.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: Notes that Professor Opal's office always smells of lavender.

entities.name: Echoverse Ral Zarek
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Ral Zarek, a black-aligned Orzhov lawmage and planeswalker who sports a mustache and goatee.

entities.name: The Ur-Sphinx
entities.description: An alternate version of the Ur-Dragon in the Echoverse; a vain, godlike telepath whose blood and magic course through every sphinx.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A telepath second only to whom is the Ur-Sphinx.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: Whose death preceded Emrakul's assault on the Echoverse.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The alternate reality in which these characters live.

events.summary: The five Founder Sphinxes, created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence, found Hexhaven to share magic with the plane's denizens.
events.quote: With the other four sphinxes, they helped found Hexhaven, sharing their knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world.

events.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds the original fortress of Hexhaven, keeping it out of reach of mage hunters.
events.quote: He used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven, keeping the campus out of reach of the mage hunters .

events.summary: In the Echoverse Josu Vess never died, so Liliana continues her studies as a healer and her spark never ignites; she becomes Professor Opal.
events.quote: In the Echoverse , Josu Vess never died, allowing his sister Liliana to continue her studies in Benalia as a healer.

events.summary: Following the death of the Theorist and Emrakul's assault on the Echoverse, the listed minor characters are presumed dead.
events.quote: all characters listed here are presumed deceased.
